title: Port @cfworker/json-schema to Python, judged by JSON-Schema-Test-Suite
prompt: /workspace holds @cfworker/json-schema, a JSON Schema validator in TypeScript. Port it to a Python 3.12 package in /workspace/python (package cfjsonschema, standard library only) with the same behaviour for drafts 2019-09 and 2020-12, exposing validate(instance, schema, draft) -> bool. Do not change the TypeScript. Reply with a short summary when done.

judge.ref: pin a main commit at prepare time (the suite has no release tags)
judge.cases: about 1,300 required cases across the two drafts
judge.image: python:3.12-slim with the suite at its commit; --cpus 4, no network

source.why: A non-systems port (TypeScript to Python) with a large, adversarial, language-independent suite; tests that worker models over-fit to visible examples.
source.prepare: Copy packages/json-schema/src and README into input/; write judge/run_suite.py (a few dozen lines: load each case, call validate, compare).
